assessments.reason: The report identifies 'ForegroundService.java' in association with the 'deVixor::Wake' Wake Lock Tag.
The class 'o/CM.java' is explicitly linked to the TRX Wallet string in the report.
The string 'deVixor_Qq1tjN49' is confirmed as the Bot ID within 'assets/port.json'.
The string 'TYDzsYUEpvnYmQk9sWMcTEd2MiAtW6' is confirmed as the TRX Wallet address in 'o/CM.java'.
The phone number '09014019397' is confirmed as the 'Offline Phone' in 'assets/off_mod.json'.
The string 'deVixor::Wake' is confirmed as the Wake Lock Tag in 'ForegroundService.java'.
The report explicitly states that the 'ir/devixor/app/' package contains the main application logic with clean, readable class names.
